reviews.title: Glitch in the app
reviews.text: I have had Mind Pal for years & am a lifetime member. It’s always been a very good app - that is until today. I was only able to access 4 of the 5 games for the workout & then not allowed to continue. After multiple attempts, I had to delete the app & download it again from the cloud before I could continue. Lost nearly a year of continuously completing the workout every day. Not really happy about that.
